name: SatishDB Cleaner — Remove Revisions & Dummy Content
author: satish

sections.description:
IMPORTANT: ALWAYS TAKE A DATABASE BACKUP BEFORE CLEANING!
This plugin includes a feature to Download Database Backup directly from the dashboard.

Plugin Features:
1. Database Backup: Download a full database backup before performing any cleanup.
2. Check database size before and after cleanup.
3. Remove revisions, dummy posts, and orphaned post meta.
4. Compatible with Gutenberg editor.
5. Supports pages, posts, and custom post types (CPTs).

Configure settings via WordPress Admin -> Settings -> SatishDB Cleaner.
sections.installation:
1. Upload satishdb-cleaner-remove-revisions folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin from Admin > Plugins menu.
  3. Navigate to Settings > SatishDB Cleaner to use the cleanup options.
